status: Unapproved static shared-scene comparison. Not runtime integration, final art acceptance, or animation.

actual_size_basis.note: Comparison has additional rows, not a fabricated gameplay viewport. Scene fitting uses opaque heights; nearest rasterization may differ at individual edge pixels.

rune.method: CPU nearest-native, subdued palette and cluster cleanup of the original level-one Rune; architecture/crystal/holder/glyph layout preserved. Not a newly generated camera angle.

processing: Exact crop/mask coordinates, nearest resizing, hard 0/255 alpha, palette/no-dither choices, isolated bright-pixel/cluster cleanup and source-facing/anchor proposals are retained in local export records and scripts. Unrestricted exports remain separate. Other lineup assets were restored to the original PNGs after model changes.
rejected: Model Rune alternatives drifted from level-one architecture and lost engraving. They remain diagnostic artifacts, not recommended runtime replacements.
limitations: Brute interior detail/contour weight remains finer than Grunt. CPU Rune retains dense engraving/spark clusters and loses some tiny marks through nearest sampling. Neither the static comparison nor generation success proves coherent final art or in-game behavior.
approval_gate: Explicit creator approval required before importing replacements. All current runtime PNGs/resources remain unchanged.
